I have analyzed the failing test case `org.apache.commons.collections.buffer.TestUnboundedFifoBuffer::testCollections220`, traced its execution, and identified the intended black-box behavior.

### Investigation Summary
* **Test Case**: [`TestUnboundedFifoBuffer.testCollections220`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/collections_8_group_c_arch/src/test/org/apache/commons/collections/buffer/TestUnboundedFifoBuffer.java#L416-L424) serializes and deserializes an empty [`UnboundedFifoBuffer`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/collections_8_group_c_arch/src/java/org/apache/commons/collections/buffer/UnboundedFifoBuffer.java#L66), and then adds an element to the deserialized buffer.
* **Failure**: When an element is added to the deserialized buffer, `buffer.size()` returns `0` instead of `1`.
* **Intended Behavior**: When an empty `UnboundedFifoBuffer` is deserialized and a new element is added, the buffer should accept the element, its size should increment to 1, and the buffer should not be empty.

The specification has been written in Gherkin/BDD format and saved to [requirement.feature](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/collections_8_group_c_arch/requirement.feature).
